# THE COMPLETE PUBLIC ROOT SURFACE. One entry per line, sorted (LC_ALL=C).
#
# .gitignore denies everything at the root and re-admits by name; this file
# is the assertion that the two agree. check-root-visibility.sh fails on a
# difference in EITHER direction -- an entry that appeared, and an entry
# that vanished -- so the public surface cannot drift silently in either.
#
# frontend/ holds one file, .nvmrc, and nothing else. deploy/ holds nothing at
# all, which is why it is NOT an entry below: git tracks files, never
# directories, so a directory with no file in it cannot be part of a public
# surface and cannot be asserted here. Both layers are specified and not built;
# the absence of code is stated in README.md rather than in a placeholder file.
# backend/ carries a pyproject.toml and an empty econflow_backend package.
#
# pyproject.toml, uv.lock and .python-version are at the ROOT and not inside
# engine/, because engine/ and backend/ are two members of ONE uv workspace
# and a workspace has exactly one lockfile. That single lock is what keeps
# both members on the same pydantic build, and it is the one place the
# dependency snapshot is pinned. The root pyproject.toml is not a package: it
# also carries the import-linter contracts that enforce "no statistic is ever
# computed outside engine/" -- the rule a file extension used to enforce
# for free.
#
# Comments and blank lines are ignored by the checker.
